item.title: DuBois Historical Society Hosting Black History Month Program
item.description: DUBOIS – In recognition of Black History Month, the DuBois Area Historical society will host a special program exploring the stories of Fudge VanCamp, a former enslaved man, Revolutionary War veteran, and one of the first Black residents of Jefferson County in the early 1800s.
